mapper.select: INSERT INTO career_plans (user_id, request_id, target_role, job_description, weeks, hours_per_week, research_market, result_json) VALUES (#{userId}, #{requestId}, #{targetRole}, #{jobDescription}, #{weeks}, #{hoursPerWeek}, #{researchMarket}, CAST(#{resultJson} AS jsonb)) RETURNING id

SELECT id, user_id, request_id, target_role, job_description, weeks, hours_per_week, research_market, result_json::text AS result_json, created_at, updated_at FROM career_plans WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_id = #{requestId}

SELECT id, user_id, request_id, target_role, job_description, weeks, hours_per_week, research_market, result_json::text AS result_json, created_at, updated_at FROM career_plans WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, user_id, request_id, target_role, job_description, weeks, hours_per_week, research_market, result_json::text AS result_json, created_at, updated_at FROM career_plans WHERE id = #{planId} AND user_id = #{userId}
